title: Quest Watersports at St. Charles RiverFest 2014
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Watersports sponsored St. Charles RiverFest, June 6-8, 2014, where visitors could try a Hobie Kayak and watch the Dragon Boat Races.
body_html: Quest Watersports is a proud sponsor of the year’s St. Charles RiverFest. Join us at the St. Charles Riverwalk Friday-Sunday, June 6-8, to try a Hobie Kayak and check out the famous Dragon Boat Races. More RiverFest info at prideofthefox.net.

seo_description: Quest Watersports sponsors St. Charles RiverFest, June 6-8, 2014 on the Riverwalk. Try a Hobie Kayak and watch the Dragon Boat Races. Ottawa, IL.
